title: Test Your Knowledge
subtitle: Eight questions from the site's pages, checked on the server.

levels: Keep exploring: the pages have all the answers.

questions.question: When was Saudi Vision 2030 launched?
questions.explanation: The Vision was announced on 25 April 2016.

questions.question: In which year was Absher established?
questions.explanation: Absher was established in 2010, and its mobile app came in 2015-2016.

questions.question: About how many unified digital IDs have been issued through Absher?
questions.explanation: More than 28 million unified digital IDs have been issued.

questions.question: What was Saudi Arabia's rank in the UN E-Government Development Index (2024)?
How many road deaths per 100,000 people were recorded in 2025?
How many automated e-gates were installed at Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and Madinah airports?
questions.explanation: 152 e-gates, built by SDAIA with Jawazat and Matarat.

questions.question: How does the National Early Warning Platform reach people?
options: Cell broadcast to every phone in the area
questions.explanation: Cell broadcast reaches every phone on the network inside the affected area.

questions.question: Who developed the Tawakkalna app?
questions.explanation: The Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA), with the Ministry of Health at launch.
